meta.title: Scientist to Senior Scientist, Molecular Biology

sections.content:
Title: Scientist to Senior Scientist, Molecular Biology (m/f/d)
Location: 100% on site, Heidelberg/Munich
Contract: Full time 
Position summary:
Kano is building next-generation genome engineering technologies to enable transformative cell-based therapies. Our platform leverages proprietary circular single-stranded DNA (cssDNA) donor technology to unlock precise, efficient, and scalable genomic insertions. By integrating advances in gene editing, immunology, and cell engineering, Kano is advancing discovery programs at the intersection of immuno-oncology and genetic medicine.
As an early-stage team, Kano offers a highly collaborative and dynamic research environment where scientists have the opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects from concept through execution. Team members work cross-functionally to develop innovative solutions, apply cutting-edge molecular and cellular biology techniques, and translate scientific insights into therapeutic strategies. This role is ideal for a driven scientist who thrives in a fast-paced setting and is motivated to push the boundaries of genome engineering and cell therapy.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
sections.content:
Work both independently and as part of a team to design, execute and optimize genomic insertion analysis in primary human cells and cell lines using Kano’s proprietary circular ssDNA donor technology
Detect gene editing outcomes using a variety of methods including flow cytometry, digital PCR, NGS and others as appropriate
Design and produce test constructs to support high-throughput screening efforts, including cloning of plasmids, manufacturing and handling of mRNA, and guide RNA design.
Design, execute, and interpret experiments with molecular biology techniques 
Design and optimize fit for purpose analytical methods, including for identification of genomic insertions and subcellular localization of nucleic acids.
Conduct literature and intellectual property reviews and aid in the ideation of potential projects 
Write protocols, prepare data presentations for company-wide meetings, maintain a highly organized and detailed electronic laboratory notebook (ELN) and stay up to date with scientific literature
Handle multiple projects effectively, prioritizing tasks, collaborate across teams with ease
